packId.description: `<role>-<person>` in kebab-case, or the slug chosen for a simulated pack.

consent.description: Who agreed to what. A pack cannot be rendered without it (ceet-core references/consent.md).

statementVersion.description: The consent statement read to the person, by version (`ceet-consent-1`).

subject.description: The person profiled, by the name or alias they chose.

basis.description: `consent`: the person agreed, after hearing the statement. `public-work`: a simulated pack of a public figure, built only from their public, work-related material; never valid for a private individual.

recordedBy.description: Who ran the interview or the simulation.

uses.description: What the person agreed the pack is for, in their words or from the statement's list.

storage.description: `local`: the pack stays on the person's machine and is git-ignored. `repository`: the person opted in to committing the shared part of the pack (never `private/`).

retention.description: How long the pack is kept, or the event that ends it.

excludedUses.description: Uses the pack may never serve, whatever else was agreed. Must list at least the uses in ceet-core's references/consent.md.

slotValue.description: A synthesized value (first person, with [Q<n>] or [E<n>] references), or an explicit gap.
